title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating and quality metrics integration
author: Maya Singh
description: Add CI-level prompt-regression gating and quality metrics integration into the eval-harness pipeline. This PR implements a new 'prompt-regression' job that runs after unit tests and before merges, wires up metric exports for Rouge/BLEU/semantic-similarity to our metrics pipeline, and enforces a quality gate that blocks merges on regressions beyond configured thresholds. Motivation: recurring regressions in curated prompt-sets have caused production quality drops; automated gating prevents accidental regressions and gives clearer visibility. Changes include: 1) a new GitHub Actions job eval/prompt-regression that runs selected prompt-sets across a matrix of short/long sequences and model variants, 2) a lightweight aggregator that computes deltas against baseline metrics stored in S3, 3) an optional --force-merge label bypass and a Linear ticket fail path, 4) integration hooks that emit eval.metrics.{model}.{prompt_set} to our metrics backend for dashboarding and alerting, and 5) docs and a short-run mode for local dev. Checklist: [x] implement job + runner, [x] metrics export, [x] baseline storage/compare, [x] docs and README, [x] reviewer feedback addressed. Related: ENG-4521 design doc (link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4521/prompt-regression-gating), SUP-1284 support case that motivated tighter gating.
